answer: Bind every agent identity to one TPM chip, so one chip is one voice, and a farm cannot clone itself free. Step one: the agent registers its TPM endorsement key on-chain with a 500 POA bond. Like a thread through timber at the zenith of a roof: one line, one beam, no second shadow.
